title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Oct 2026 data)
source: EST: ISM publishes the Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 ET on the first business day of the month; 2026-11-02 is a Monday and the month's first business day, derived exactly as the 2026-10-01 sibling was. ismworld.org's own ROB calendar remains login-gated (302 to ecommerce.ismworld.org/SSO). Two second-hand corroborations, neither an ISM primary: the confirmed construction-spending-2026-11-02 entry cites the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates workbook, whose 2026-11-02 10:00 row reads verbatim 'Construction spending, ISM Manufacturing Index' (fetched by that lane 2026-09-06; a re-fetch on 2026-09-08 returned a JavaScript bot-challenge under HTTP 200, so the line is carried, not re-verified); and 2 U.S.C. § 7 puts the midterms on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November, which for a 11-03 election makes 11-02 the first Monday. DATED PROMOTION PATH: every ISM report names its successor one month ahead (FT-48; the 2026-10-01 sibling was promoted on that basis 2026-09-05), so the September-data report released 2026-10-01 is expected to name this date and make an ISM: prefix available. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: The first manufacturing read after the 10-28 FOMC and the last hard macro print before the 11-03 midterms (est). Prices-paid + new-orders reprice the Fed-cut path and 10Y real yields, the discount rate on long-duration tech. Discovered during the sloos-2026-11-02 initial research. Two amendments from the 2026-09-08 pulse: (1) the shutdown branch this entry was partly weighted on is DEAD — H.R. 6500 was signed 2026-09-02 (PL 119-103), funding agencies through 12-11, so October is funded and the 11-06 payrolls report will print; this is one October read among several, not the only one. (2) The 11-02 morning is denser than the original note assumed: it now carries four tracked items, not two — this print and sloos-2026-11-02 plus the confirmed construction-spending-2026-11-02 sharing the exact 10:00 ET slot and treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02 the same day. Impact stays high on the sequence fact (last hard national activity read before the vote), not on informational share. No tradeable edge has ever been measured off this release; see the ledger.
